## Claim amendment (area o3-H) · 2026-11-17T19:24Z

Amends claim 6956247467, `File surface:` line, for PR #34960, before its L1 read:

File surface (stated): the pins sit in the existing shared harness files `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.colors.test.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardChart.chartConfigMarks-4044.test.tsx` (already "existing shared harness tests"), per AGENTS.md's shared-harness rule (ruling record 6583487846).
File surface (added): `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.catalogRender-6939.test.tsx`. Its catalog render census counts `linearGradient` / `stop` elements, and that count grows with the palette, so this change made the pinned numbers stale. They are re-pinned in the same PR (+10 gradients, +20 stops, +30 elements per fixture; the text hash is unchanged). This is a mechanical follow-on of the change, not a widening of it.

Nothing else in the claim changes (Clause-②: no, Metadata-protocol: none, Fixes #34902).

## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T19:25Z

Seat 3 widens this card's surface by two lists the dev found that still stop at `--chart-5`, so the ten-token set lands whole in one PR (#34960):

- `ui/packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts`: generated apps emit `--chart-1`…`--chart-10` (light and dark), so a pie with six or more slices in a generated app no longer points at undefined tokens.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-responsive-styles.ts`: the known-token list runs to `--chart-10`.

Pin each (a generated app carries all ten tokens; lint accepts `--chart-6`…`--chart-10` and still flags an unknown one). Declarations unchanged unless the measured diff says otherwise.
